_comment: Hooking-title formula bank for the long-form engine's Packaging/Hook modules. Generate 3-5 variants/video using DIFFERENT formulas, then A/B test and feed winners back via the retention loop. Sourced from Q2 2026 research (see YT_Longform_Trends_2026Q2.md). Each title MUST be paid off by the cold open or 2026 'Click-and-Quit' scoring demotes it.

rules.numbers: specific, ideally odd (7, 9, 13); precise beats round
rules.brackets: one closing (...) or [...] reliably lifts CTR — scope, curiosity kicker, or friction-remover
rules.caps: selective CAPS on ONE word only; never ALL CAPS + '!!!'
rules.title_first: write title before scripting; cold open (first 15-30s) must cash the title's open loop

formulas.psychology: max density for min investment; precise time = credible

formulas.example: The Entire History of Rome, Explained
formulas.psychology: definitive single resource; closes the 'I'd have to research this' loop

formulas.example: The Decision That Started a War
formulas.psychology: names category, hides specific — open loop the brain wants closed

formulas.example: The Man Who Saved The World
formulas.psychology: personalizes a huge event into one human's stakes
layer-by-layer 'how deep does it go?' loop pulls viewers through long runtime
pattern-interrupt + scannable scope; odd outperforms even

formulas.template: What They're NOT Telling You About [TOPIC]  |  The Real Reason [X]
formulas.example: What They Never Told You About the Titanic
Former Detective Explains the Case That Was Never Solved
formulas.psychology: answers 'why trust this' before it's asked

formulas.example: You've Consumed Enough. It's Time to Start Creating.
formulas.psychology: confronts self-image; personal pronouns lift CTR

formulas.example: My Exact Framework for Researching Any Topic
formulas.psychology: signals a replicable system / legitimate shortcut

formulas.template: Stop Doing [X] If You Want [RESULT]  |  Why Your [X] Is Failing
formulas.example: Stop Using This Strategy in 2026 (It's Killing Your Channel)
formulas.psychology: loss aversion + urgency; avoid-a-mistake beats gain-a-benefit

formulas.example: Tesla vs Edison: Who Really Won?
formulas.psychology: viewers hold an opinion and click to validate it or get a verdict
brain auto-tries to answer; can't, so it clicks

formulas.example: He Had 12 Minutes to Stop a Nuclear War
formulas.psychology: MrBeast principle: most extreme honest claim = highest click

formulas.template: Why [COMMON_BELIEF] Is Wrong  |  The [TOPIC] Myth Nobody Talks About
formulas.example: Why Everything You Know About the Pyramids Is Wrong
formulas.psychology: cognitive dissonance; click to defend belief or learn the twist

ab_test_workflow.rule: each variant uses a DIFFERENT formula
ab_test_workflow.test: YouTube Studio native A/B title test (needs 1k+ subs)
ab_test_workflow.feedback: log CTR per formula in the ledger; promote winning formulas as higher-weight templates
